articleTitle: Modelling and optimisation of stand alone power generation at rural area
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Hydroelectric power is one of the important renewable energy sources. It converts the potential energy of the natural circulating water flows to usable electrical energy by driving a turbine which is connected to a generator. In the rural area of Sabah state in Malaysia, such as Kampung Terian, the existing micro-hydro power plant is incapable to support the villagers' demand during the peak hours. Meanwhile, the tremendous amount of excess energy is wasted by disposing through ballast load during the non-peak hours. Since the discharge coefficient parameter of charging system is dynamically changed in nature, the conventional proportional controller is unable to control the charging process well. Thus, a lead-acid battery storage system is developed to incorporate with the micro-hydro power plant. Fuzzy logic control is proposed in this work to control the amount of current charging for the battery by manipulating the duty cycle of a DC-DC buck converter.

articleTitle: Distributed firewall for P2P network in data center
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Data center is an important form of cloud computing, network security of data center is also very important. The firewall has been used widely as an important tool for network security. This paper described a firewall named DC-Firewall for virtual machines in a data center, especially for the virtual machines in a P2P network. Different from previous research, this paper wants to emphasize the importance of distributed model and message control in the study of network security in data centers. The discussion of distributed architecture forms the major concern of the present study. For different topology of P2P network, DC-Firewall used modular design to provide extensibility of architecture. Some useful implications obtained from this system include the architecture of distributed firewalls and message-oriented engine in software defined P2P networks.

articleTitle: Authentication for electrical charging of EVs in the private area considering E-roaming
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: The smart grid has been a hot issue in the research and the industrial areas after study started in the early 2000s. The Electric Vehicle (EV) is an important component in the smart grids, playing a role of the electrical storage component with high capacity, so that how to charge EVs is recognized as a critical issue. As a new concept - the E-roaming is recently introduced, how to introduce the EV charging system in the private area needs to be thought in the interaction with E-roaming system. We propose an authentication system to discriminate an individual user and vehicle in the private area when charging the EVs.

articleTitle: A high efficiency charge pump with continuous frequency charge sharing scheme
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: In this paper, the charge pump efficiency is discussed, and a charge pump with continuous frequency charge sharing scheme is presented. The proposed charge sharing clock generator is able to recover the charge from parasitic-capacitor charging and discharging, so that the dynamic power loss is reduced by half. Furthermore, the proposed frequency regulation structure is able to keep the efficiency of charge pump at the theoretical maximum value without effect of load current. The simulation results show a maximum 10% efficiency increase and the efficiency is kept around 68% when load current decreases, while efficiency of conventional charge pump drops to 23% when load current is 10uA.

articleTitle: Message-oriented protocol for cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: To combined the mobile cloud computing and the data center cloud computing, especially for the applications run cross the mobile devices and virtual machines in data center, the unified message protocol is needed. In this paper we described a kind of message-oriented protocol, and one implementation of the protocol is given under mobile and data center scenarios. The homologous test data is also shown in this paper, and improvement direction is provided by comparing with other similar systems.

articleTitle: Human eye characteristics in IR-based eye detection
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Nowadays, IR-based (IR means infrared) eye detection technology is widely used. However, many previous work on IR-based eye detection only focuses on the theory of IR image processing and neglect the important influence of human eye characteristics on the sensor design and image generation. Therefore, robustness can not be guaranteed. In this paper, we propose a new reduced eye model based on the Gullstrand's schematic eye. This eye model can serve as a quantitative factor of system design. Using both simulation and experiments, we illustrate the correctness and feasibility of our model.

articleTitle: High dynamic range tone mapping optimization on perceptual quality and processor specific efficiency
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: With the popularization of high dynamic range (HDR) devices, many tone mapping techniques have been proposed. By analyzing the relationship between the architecture of specific processors and path-wise retinex tone mapping technique, and by applying perceptual quality assessment of images collected from human observers, this paper proposes a novel path-wise retinex optimization method. A peculiar feature of this approach is the way its parameters can be adjusted to tradeoff its performance in speed and in perceptual quality. Experiments and results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Dense depth recovery based on adaptive image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Stereoscopic vision has been a hot research topic in recent years. As one of the most important steps for 3D reconstruction from image sequences, dense depth recovery has attracted much attention in computer vision recently. A lot of efficient algorithms based on stereo matching have been proposed. But the difficulties in depth recovery are not overcome completely yet. In this paper, we aim at the main problems of depth recovery and propose our solutions. And an effective approach for dense depth recovery based on adaptive image segmentation is also presented. Experiments show that accurate depth results can be achieved through the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A new multistep interpolation method for carrier recovery in the presence of phase noise
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: The paper deals with pilot-aided carrier recovery in single-carrier systems. The system model considered in the paper includes the frequency offset and the phase noise that come from the local oscillators used for up/down-conversion. A multistep interpolation method is introduced to estimate the phase error assuming that a sequence of equally spaced pilot symbols is available. Our analysis takes the statistical character of phase noise into consideration and obtains the optimal coefficient of pilot to estimate the phase noise. The method proposed in the paper is compared with other method in the previous paper through simulation.

articleTitle: A novel adaptive filter for interference suppression
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: In wireless communication systems of consumer electronics, it is very important to suppress the interference and extract the target effectively without any phase-amplitude shift. A number of signal processing optimal algorithms developed, we apply the smart antenna to adaptive filtering. But the performances of adaptive filtering differ from each other corresponding to different algorithms. The linear constraint minimum variance (LCMV) criteria shall be applicable to the case of lower array signal noise ratio (ASNR), while the interference suppression criteria shall be applicable to the opposite case. We can get the best performance in any cases using the maximum signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (MSINR) criteria, but sometimes it has application limitations. To solve this problem, an alterable parameter adaptive filter is proposed, which minimizes the output noise power under a premise, that is, there exists no shift from the target and the interference can be suppressed to a certain extent. The methods of the alterable parameter estimation are discussed, and performance analyses and simulation results are given as well. It can be concluded from the results that a nearly ideal output signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) of the novel adaptive filter can be expected, keeping the original phase and amplitude of the target.

articleTitle: Resources sharing in HEVC de-blocking filter core
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: The up-coming video compression standard, high efficiency video coding (HEVC), reduces 50% bit rates in encoding video sequences with same picture quality compared to H.264/AVC. The de-blocking filter is an important part in HEVC. By exploiting the arithmetic operation of HEVC de-blocking filter, we propose a HEVC de-blocking filter core in which resources share techniques are used to reduce the hardware cost. We divide the HEVC de-blocking filter into 2 parts: one is strong luma filter (SLF), the other is weak luma and chroma filter (WLCF). In the strong luma filter, common parts for the arithmetic operations to obtain the filtered pixels are extracted. In the weak luma and chroma filter, the chroma de-blocking filtering can be implemented as a subset of weak luma filtering. By using the proposed techniques, the cost of de-blocking filter is greatly lowered.

articleTitle: An efficient gradual scene boundary detection algorithm for H.264/AVC in compressed domain
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Scene boundary detection is the essential step for video analysis such as retrieval, indexing, browsing and so on. There have been quite a lot of scene boundary detection methods for MPEG video streams and they work well. However, the variable size of macroblocks and more type information of macroblocks in H.264/AVC bitstreams make it different from MPEG bitstreams. Consequently, most of the algorithms can not be applied to the H.264/AVC directly. In this paper, an algorithm based on the percentage of blocks coded with the same mode in each frame is proposed. After analyzing the statistics of type information of the sequence contain gradual scene changes, the algorithm sets appropriate thresholds to locate the gradual scene boundaries. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs well and can detect 90.9% of the boundaries and make few false alarms.

articleTitle: NFC-based personal information management for U-health
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Recently many of the smart phones that have been rapidly spread have NFC functionality. In this paper we have developed a U-health system to get data from sensors attached to the body and let doctors and patients properly utilize it. We have first considered how to get data from sensors and used the Zigbee module to collect data and transfer it to the NFC module. Then we have decided the authentication system for security on data delivery from NFC. Finally, we have designed a database schema to make the data useful.

articleTitle: Novel positioning scheme with single base station for high speed train in WiMax systems
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: A novel positioning scheme based on the specific communication network for high-speed train (HST) with a single base station (BS) is presented. In order to improve the accuracy of TOA estimation, the proposed method utilizes the cumulative sum of time-of-arrival (TOA) estimation values, which are measured during the initial ranging (IR) and periodical ranging (PR) process of each mobile station (MS). When the HST gets close to the BS, a positioning algorithm based on angle- of-arrival (AOA) estimation is employed to guarantee the accuracy of positioning. Simulation results are implemented under the mobile worldwide interoperability for microwave access (WiMax) configuration, showing that the proposed scheme dramatically improves the accuracy and reliability of TOA estimation. Furthermore, by using the combined scheme of TOA and AOA estimation, real-time and accurate location information could be provided for HST.

articleTitle: A message transmission system for opportunistic networks
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: An opportunistic network is a type of challenged networks, which has not any stable end-to-end delivery path between source nodes and destination nodes, and the messages are transmitted by the “store-carry-and-forward” paradigm when message-carrying nodes encounter other nodes until they reach the destination nodes. In this paper, we design a message transmission system—BlueChat—for opportunistic networks by Bluetooth protocol, which includes a routing protocol and a message queue management strategy. Performance of this system is tested and it could meet the message transmission needs of opportunistic networks.

articleTitle: Fast coding tree unit decision for HEVC intra coding
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: The Quad-tree structure in HEVC contributes to significant coding efficiency improvement, especially for high resolution videos. However, its recursive representation increases the coding complexity as well. This paper brings forward a fast coding tree uint algorithm to speed up the original intra coding in HEVC. By analyzing the texture of the CU, to filter out some unnecessary CU candidates. In the paper, two variables are used to evaluate the texture of the CU, that is the sobel gradient and MAD value. Combined these two values, encoding of some CUs can be skipped. Experimental results show that the algorithm obtains around 30% of time reduction with nearly unchanged PSNR and bitrate stays almost the same compared with the original HEVC intra coding.

articleTitle: Automatic delineation of single-lead electrocardiograph fiducial points based on the hierarchical triple-extreme-points model
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: This paper introduces a novel single-lead electrocardiograph (ECG) automatic delineator based on the hierarchical triple-extreme-points model (HTM) and self-learning, featuring high robustness, low computational cost and mathematical simplicity. By applying HTM to obtaining the local morphological features of ECG signals, this method is capable of precisely detecting QRS complexes, P-wave and T-wave. In the experimental studies, this method was validated by several standard real-world ECG databases, including MIT-BIH arrhythmia, QT, European ST-T and TWA Challenge 2008 databases. For QRS detection, the average sensitivity value was 99.74% and the positive predictivity value was 99.80% for all databases. In the meantime, for P-wave and T-wave detection on QT, the sensitivity values were 99.49% and 99.81% respectively and the positive predictivity values were 98.82 and 99.80% respectively. As to delineation, the average maximum delineation error was no more than 4 ms and the standard deviation error was around 10ms for P-wave, QRS complex and T-wave.

articleTitle: Design and development of portable fuzzy logic based traffic optimizer
publicationTitle: 2013 IEEE International Conference on Consumer Electronics - China
abstract: Traffic jam has become a common scene nowadays, due to the rapid increase of road users in the past few years. To solve this problem, the design of traffic control is required. Traffic control parameter can be determined from the traffic flow behavior of the traffic intersection. Currently, most of the traffic control system in Malaysia is using Webster Model, which its green time duration is pre-determined by collecting the data from the traffic intersection. Most of the waiting time at the intersection is wasted due to the constant green time duration. The aim of this paper is to optimize the average waiting time of a traffic intersection via a developed Fuzzy Logic traffic control system. Traffic light simulator hardware is built to deal with the difficulties of working in a real environment and to investigate the performance of the traffic control system. Conventional traffic control system, Webster Model and the Fuzzy Logic controller will be applied into the traffic signal simulator in order to investigate their performance.
